description: Source code for A2A Streaming Iterator class with token tracking and logging support, used for handling streaming responses, extracting text, counting tokens, and logging usage and costs.

classes.name: A2AStreamingIterator
classes.description: An asynchronous iterator for handling A2A streaming responses, with token tracking, logging, and cost calculation features.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the streaming iterator with stream, request, logging object, and agent name.

methods.name: __anext__
methods.description: Retrieves the next chunk from the stream, processes it, and handles stream completion.

methods.name: _collect_text_from_chunk
methods.description: Extracts text from a streaming chunk for token counting.

methods.name: _is_completed_chunk
methods.description: Checks if a chunk indicates the end of the stream.

methods.name: _handle_stream_complete
methods.description: Handles logging, token counting, and cost calculation when the stream completes.

methods.name: _build_logging_result
methods.description: Builds a dictionary with logging information, including usage and final chunk data.
